notes.title: New Smoothcade Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey there! 

We hope you're having a fantastic start to 2024! To kick things off right, we've got a special treat just for you: a shiny [b]new demo of Smoothcade[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658701/1a114c5463649f24392d182cb5a29bc3e0cb1ce3.png[/img]

This version is packed with some awesome quality of life improvements, a few pesky bugs squashed, and to top it off, we've even added a brand new unlockable character! 

While we're putting the finishing touches on the full release, we invite you to take your time and dive into our demo. Have fun!

Here's the complete list of all the changes in the new demo build:

[list]
[*] [b]Quality:[/b] Improved menu navigation.
[*] [b]Quality:[/b] Added a "Restart Level" option from the Pause menu while in Replay mode.
[*] [b]Quality: [/b]Added a fullscreen/windowed toggle hotkey by pressing F11.
[*] [b]Quality:[/b] Indicator arrows now present on level 1 and level 2 to help players notice the Control signs.
[*] [b]Quality:[/b] Adjustments made to default music loudness.
[*] [b]Quality:[/b] Adjusted hit boxes on certain enemies to improved player experience.
[*] [b]Quality: [/b]Adjustments made to Story mode levels to improve player experience.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Quitting from the Pause menu in Replay mode directed players to the Main Menu. Now it returns players to the Replay Level Select screen.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Every level begins with text near the top that shows the level's goal.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Removed an invisible ledge present on two demo levels.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed overlapping text on Online Leaderboards.
[*] [b]Other:[/b] Added one more unlockable character in Story mode.
[/list]
